Stop Purchasing Rio Tinto plc Sponsored ADR
: Chinese authorities told steel mills to temporarily stop buying Rio Tinto plc Sponsored ADR (RIO) iron ore, pausing those mills' purchases of the company's ore for the guidance period.
: Rio Tinto (RIO) signed a project agreement with Nyangumarta Warrarn to develop the Winu copper‑gold mine in Western Australia. Rio holds 70% of the JV with Sumitomo (30%).
RIO Drops On Copper Tariff News
: Rio Tinto plc Sponsored ADR (RIO) slid ~2.7% after reports of possible White House refined copper tariffs. Officials reportedly undecided, fueling volatility in copper-linked stocks including RIO.

: Bernstein revised its price target for Rio Tinto plc Sponsored ADR (RIO) upward to $89.50 per share from $88.50; the change is a one-step increase in the firm's published target value for the stock.
